function.name: get_detail_adriel_project
function.description: Retrieves the detailed information of a specific project that Adriel was working on, including the project's status and start date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_name.description: The unique name identifier for the project.

include_financials.description: Flag to determine if financial details should be included in the response.

response_format.description: The desired format of the response data.

start_date.description: The starting date of the project in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2021-04-12'. If not provided, defaults to the project's actual start date.

function.name: get_adriel_detail_experience_and_education
function.description: Retrieves the detailed information regarding Adriel's specific experiences and educational background. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

experience_or_education_type.description: The category of Adriel's experience or education to fetch details for.

function.name: get_adriel_list_projects
function.description: Retrieve a list of projects that Adriel has worked on, optionally filtered by status. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose projects are to be fetched.

status.description: The current status of the projects to filter by.

include_dates.description: Determines if start and end dates of the projects should be included in the response.

function.name: get_adriel_experiences_and_education
function.description: Retrieve a combined list of Adriel's professional experiences and academic qualifications. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user for whom the experiences and education details are to be fetched.

include_references.description: Determines whether to include reference contacts for each experience and education entry.

date_format.description: The expected date format for any date fields in the experiences and education entries, such as 'MM/DD/YYYY'.

function.name: get_adriel_profile
function.description: Retrieve the full profile information for the user Adriel, including personal details and account settings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user whose profile is being retrieved.

include_private.description: A flag indicating whether to include private details in the profile.

function.name: get_adriel_tech_stack
function.description: Retrieves a list of technologies that Adriel has experience working with, including programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
